title: 实战：DeepSeek-V4 拼装
note_on_kind: Part VI 收官 capstone 代码章（非 primer），**无精简版**（Lead 指令：subtraction_plan 留空，Implement/Test 站跳过）——writer 直接吃 embed_excerpts + stations + mechanisms。本章性质：把 ch23（拼装契约/registry/权重流入）、ch25（MLA 两种展开）、ch26（稀疏索引器/compressor/三类层）、ch27（FP8/FP4 量化数学）四块积木装回一台真实旗舰 DeepSeek-V4，验证 Part VI hook『接入新架构只需拼层——Attention 是插座不是实现』的成色与接入税。v0.27 关键事实：DSV4 已从 v2 时代的扁平 model_executor/models/deepseek_v4.py（v0.21）整体迁入 vllm/models/deepseek_v4/{common,nvidia,amd,xpu} 硬件隔离新布局（git 287471b99 '[Model Refactoring] Migrate DeepSeek V4 to vllm/models/ [1/N]' #43004）——v2 档案全部行号作废、本章锚点已逐个对 v0.27.1 重核。与 v0.21 的结构差（正文要点）：①残差展开从 Model.forward 里显式 unsqueeze/repeat 变成首层 mhc_pre_broadcast_tilelang 核内广播（fn_broadcast 预折权重重算）；②hc 核从 torch.ops.vllm.mhc_pre/post 自定义算子换成 tilelang 核族封装（kernels/mhc/tilelang.py），post+pre 融合成单核且 RMSNorm 可融；③MoE 双后端选择权从探测逻辑上收为 kernel_config.moe_backend 显式旋钮；④新增 hash MoE（前 num_hash_layers 层按 token id 查表路由）、EPLB 冗余专家装载、序列并行（sp_shard/all_gather/reduce_scatter）；⑤attention 拆成包根平台 ABC（attention.py）+ nvidia/amd/xpu 子类（forward_mqa/_o_proj/get_padded_num_q_heads 抽象方法）；⑥breakable cudagraph：attention_impl 挂 @eager_break_during_capture。考纲第三条『code→diagram 方法论』：末节教读者从 config.json+源码树自己画出本章的模型层全景图（registry 查表→__init__ 树→forward 走线三步法）——L2 图即样板答案。边界：MLA 两种展开与后端家族归 ch25、indexer/compressor/一核双源归 ch26、量化数学归 ch27（本章只讲布局与字节账）、投机解码驱动归 ch32/33（本章只讲 MTP 钩子）、EP/SP 深讲归 ch34、D4-Flash 部署实战归 ch35。

one_line: 模型定义层拼装术的期末考：DeepseekV4ForCausalLM 的模型文件仍只做层组装+权重名映射（ch23 契约原样成立），但每一块积木都升了级——①残差：标准 add-norm → mHC 多流残差，hidden 以 (residual, post_mix, res_mix) 三件套+2D layer 输入在层间穿针，每半层一个 mhc_fused_post_pre_tilelang 融合核（post+pre+RMSNorm 一核），首层 2D embed 由 mhc_pre_broadcast 核内展开成 hc_mult 条流、层尾 mhc_post 塌回 3D 后先喂 _mtp_hidden_buffer（pre-hc_head 残差）再 hc_head 压回单流；②注意力：第三代 MLA——包根平台 ABC DeepseekV4Attention（fused_wqa_wkv 复制不切 TP 的低秩瓶颈 + attn_sink 垫 -inf + wo_a/wo_b 输出低秩 + 四本 KV 账：主 MLA 584B/token fp8_ds_mla / IndexerCache / CompressorStateCache / SWACache）+ nvidia/amd/xpu 子类实现 forward_mqa/_o_proj（FlashMLA 子类把头垫到 64/128、输出侧 fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant→fp8_einsum(wo_a)→wo_b）；③FFN：DeepseekV4MoE 双后端——kernel_config.moe_backend=='deep_gemm_mega_moe' 时 EP+SM100+fp4+sqrtsoftplus 全限定走 DeepseekV4MegaMoEExperts（w13=[E,2I,H/2]uint8 + scale=[E,2I,H/32]UE8M0 的 FP4 字节布局，finalize_weights 变换成 DeepGEMM 布局后丢弃装载参数），否则走通用 FusedMoE 工厂；路由 scores=sqrt(softplus(gate))、e_score_correction_bias 只影响选择不影响权重，前 num_hash_layers 层 tid2eid 查表免打分；④数值：DeepseekV4FP8Config 按 expert_dtype 惰性分发 Mxfp4MoEMethod/Fp8MoEMethod/NVFP4，e8m0fnu scale 必须 .view(uint8) 装载；⑤出口：compute_logits 契约原样 + get_mtp_target_hidden_states 钩子（runner 侧 getattr 探测重绑 drafter 输入，draft 侧 e_proj/h_proj 融合后复用整层 DecoderLayer、hc_head 推迟到 compute_logits）。接入税的真实账单：平台子类×3、四本账 spec、三处手动 static_forward_context 注册、per-expert_dtype 权重 mapper、多流 overlap 的 eager break 与 scratch 池。

stations.what: arch 字符串进厂：hf_config.architectures=['DeepseekV4ForCausalLM'] 查表得 ('vllm.models.deepseek_v4','DeepseekV4ForCausalLM')——新布局条目写全限定模块路径，_resolve_module_name（L1439-L1446）见 vllm. 前缀原样保留、其余拼 model_executor.models 前缀；同一张表往上两行（L94）DeepseekV32ForCausalLM 仍走扁平 deepseek_v2——新旧两套布局并存（ch23 站 1 已立机制，本章看真身）。DSparkDraftModel（L617）与 DeepSeekV4MTPModel（L643）条目同款。

平台分发：current_platform.is_rocm()/is_xpu() 三岔 import amd/xpu/nvidia 各自的 DeepseekV4ForCausalLM+DeepSeekV4MTP+DSparkDeepseekV4ForCausalLM 并 re-export——registry 与量化查找只认 __all__ 四个公共名（L34-L39）；DeepseekV4FP8Config 在包根无平台分。『一层到底谁实现』自此跨目录：基座在包根 attention.py，平台子类在 nvidia/。

顶层拼装：DeepseekV4ForCausalLM(nn.Module, SupportsPP, SupportsEagle3, DeepseekV4MixtureOfExperts)——bases 即 ch23 站 5 的 hasattr 探测靶。__init__ 读 expert_dtype（默认 fp4）选 per-instance 的 hf_to_vllm_mapper（类属性默认 fp4 版、实例覆盖，L1462-L1473）；装 DeepseekV4Model + 末 rank ParallelLMHead + LogitsProcessor；make_empty_intermediate_tensors 挂别名；set_moe_parameters（L1493-L1510）遍历层登记 moe_mlp_layers/expert 数——EPLB/分布式要的 MoE 元数据装配期一次算好。

骨架与三池：DeepseekV4Model.__init__ 除 embed/make_layers/norm 外开三个全模型共享池——①3 条 cuda.Stream（注释点名给 compressor kv_score/indexer.weights_proj/indexer.compressor kv_score 三个轻 GEMM，fused_wqa_wkv 留默认流）②DeepseekV4EagerScratchPool（eager break 里不再裸分配）③topk_indices_buffer [max_num_batched_tokens, index_topk]（ch26 站 1 同款）；再加 hc_head_fn/base/scale 三个 fp32 参数与 _mtp_hidden_buffer（spec_config 用 eagle/draft_model 才建，L1095-L1106）。PP 中间张量=(T, hc_mult, hidden)——多流在首层前展开、hc_head 前不塌缩（L1111-L1129 注释）。

DecoderLayer 装配：attn=_select_dsv4_attn_cls（L771-L802：按 attention_config.backend+设备能力选 FlashMLA/FlashInfer(SM120)/FlashInfer 子类，不显式指定时 SM12 默认 FlashInfer、其余 FlashMLA）；ffn=DeepseekV4MoE；attn_norm/ffn_norm 两个 RMSNorm（weight/eps 后面喂给 hc 核——norm 融进核）；hc_attn_fn/hc_ffn_fn/hc_attn_base/hc_ffn_base/hc_attn_scale/hc_ffn_scale 六组 fp32 混合参数，形状 (2+hc_mult, hc_mult×hidden)——『学习式混合』的参数账。

MLA 第三代装配（平台 ABC 的共享 __init__）：fused_wqa_wkv=Merged([q_lora_rank, head_dim]) 且 disable_tp=True（低秩瓶颈复制不切 TP）；q_norm→wq_b 列切上投；kv_norm(head_dim)；wo_a（n_groups×o_lora_rank，bmm 视图）/wo_b 行切=输出侧低秩两段；attn_sink 按 padded_heads 填 -inf；compress_ratio==4 才建 DeepseekV4Indexer（复用 aux_stream_list[2]）、>1 建 DeepseekCompressor；kv_cache_dtype 解析成 fp8_ds_mla/uint8 并回写 cache_config；DeepseekV4SWACache；**手动**注册 static_forward_context（重复名即 raise）。

MoE 装配：use_mega_moe=（kernel_config.moe_backend=='deep_gemm_mega_moe'）——mega 必须 EP、只支持 sqrtsoftplus、只支持 expert_dtype=fp4（三条 NotImplementedError 都带修法提示，L536-L561）；gate=GateLinear(out_dtype=fp32)；hash MoE——前 num_hash_layers 层 gate.tid2eid=randint(vocab, topk)（dummy 模式用 randint 防 garbage、注释原话）；topk_method=='noaux_tc' 时挂 e_score_correction_bias；shared_experts=DeepseekV4MLP（mega 下 reduce_results=use_mega_moe——EP 下免 all_reduce）；_init_mega_moe_experts（EP 切物理专家+冗余专家账）/_init_fused_moe_experts（FusedMoE 工厂，TP 切）二岔。

FP4/FP8 分发：override_quantization_method（L134-L152）把 fp8/deepseek_v4_fp8/Quark-MXFP4-OCP 的 V4 checkpoint 报名成 'deepseek_v4_fp8'（注册于 vllm/model_executor/layers/quantization/__init__.py:L164）；expert_dtype **惰性**解析（构造时 set_current_vllm_config 还没生效，急切读恒见默认 fp4 且 silently misroute Flash-Base——docstring NOTE 原话，L43-L47）；get_quant_method（L173-L194）：RoutedExperts+fp4→Mxfp4MoEMethod（moe_quant_algo=='NVFP4' 时 ModelOptNvFp4FusedMoE）、fp8→落回 Fp8Config 的 Fp8MoEMethod；is_scale_e8m0=（expert_dtype=='fp4'）——线性 scale 是 UE8M0 还是 f32 由它定。

权重流入+finalize：stacked 映射 wq_a+wkv→fused_wqa_wkv、compressor wkv+wgate→fused_wkv_wgate、w1/w3→gate_up（L1218-L1226）；expert_mapping 一次性预计算（mega 用 make_deepseek_v4_expert_params_mapping、fused 用 fused_moe_make_expert_params_mapping，L1353-L1365）；e8m0fnu scale 必须 .view(torch.uint8) 装载（数值 copy_ 会 destroy 原始指数字节，L1270-L1279 注释）；attn_sink 按 head_rank 窄切（L1307-L1314）；block-FP8 shared_experts 按 TP 块对齐补零（_pad_shared_expert_weight L1328-L1351）；load_weights 尾部两步 finalize——finalize_mega_moe_weights（transform_weights_for_mega_moe 后丢弃原参数）+ finalize_mhc_broadcast_weights（首层 fn.view(-1,hc_mult,H).sum(1) 预折，L1371-L1380）。

运行期主干：首 rank embed 出 2D (T,H)——不再显式 repeat，首层核内广播展开；mega_moe 下 input_ids 先 int64 化（hash 路由查表要）；sp_shard 序列并行入口；逐层 4 元组 (hidden_states, residual, post_mix, res_mix) 穿针；aux_hidden_state_layers 命中层用 mhc_post 重建 aux 流（EAGLE3 draft 要）；层尾 mhc_post 塌回 (T, hc_mult, H) → **先** copy_ 进 _mtp_hidden_buffer（pre-hc_head 残差，MTP 的原料）**再** hc_head 压回单流 → norm。PP 非末 rank 以多流形状直接打包 IntermediateTensors。

单层两半（hc 门控骨架）：residual is None 时首层特判——x.dim()==2 走 mhc_pre_broadcast_tilelang（用 finalize 预折的 fn_broadcast）、否则普通 mhc_pre；其后每半层一个 mhc_fused_post_pre_tilelang（上一个 post+下一个 pre+RMSNorm 融合成单核）；attn 半被 sp_all_gather/sp_reduce_scatter 包住（序列并行只在 attn 段生效）；ffn 半收尾返回 4 元组。RMSNorm 不再是独立层——weight/eps 拆出来传给 hc 核。

Attention 一拍：forward（L350-L396）预分配 padded_heads 输出缓冲 → attn_gemm_parallel_execute（L403-L459：fused_wqa_wkv 默认流 + compressor/indexer 三轻 GEMM aux 流，VLLM_MULTI_STREAM_GEMM_TOKEN_THRESHOLD 门控、ROCm 顺序回退）→ split+fused_q_kv_rmsnorm → attention_impl（L461-L540，@eager_break_during_capture：C4A 三路 overlap——默认流 wq_b+qnorm+RoPE+kv_insert / aux[0] 整个 indexer / aux[1] compressor；breakable cudagraph 捕获期多流禁用回退顺序）→ forward_mqa（平台核）→ _o_proj（fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant→fp8_einsum(wo_a)→wo_b）。

MoE 一拍：mega 路=gate(hidden)→fused_topk_bias（scores=sqrt(softplus(g))、bias 只影响选择；hash 层直接查 tid2eid）→experts(topk_weights/ids, activation_clamp=swiglu_limit)（内部 prepare_megamoe_inputs 量化+重排进对称缓冲 → deep_gemm.fp8_fp4_mega_moe 单算子）→+=shared_experts；fused 路=is_internal_router 时 router 在 MoERunner 内部（hidden 直喂）、否则外部 gate 先算再进 FusedMoE（shared_experts 聚合在内部）。

出口与 MTP 钩子：compute_logits→LogitsProcessor（与 Llama 同款两行——采样位切片策略仍归 runner，ch23 站 11/12 契约在旗舰上原样成立）；get_mtp_target_hidden_states 返回 _mtp_hidden_buffer（pre-hc_head 残差 (max_num_batched_tokens, hc_mult×H)）。消费端：runner 在采样后 getattr 探测重绑 drafter 输入（vllm/v1/worker/gpu_model_runner.py:L5198-L5206）；draft 侧 DeepSeekV4MTP（nvidia/mtp.py）e_proj/h_proj 融合 embed+prev residual → 复用整层 DecoderLayer → 返回 flat 残差、hc_head 推迟到自己的 compute_logits（L253-L279）。驱动机制（propose/verify/拒绝采样）归 ch32/33。

stations_note: 站号 = DSV4 在模型层的生命周期流经顺序：第 1-9 站装配幕（一生一次：registry→平台分发→顶层→骨架→DecoderLayer→MLA→MoE→FP4 分发→权重流入），第 10-14 站运行幕（一拍之内：主干→单层两半→Attention 一拍→MoE 一拍→出口+MTP 钩子）。正文建议编排：开场用 delta over Llama 对照立『这台旗舰比基线多了什么』（capstone 主题句），沿装配幕 1-9 走（每站强调『ch23 契约哪条没变、哪条升级了』），再沿运行幕 10-14 走一拍（hc 4 元组穿针是主线暗线：数据形状从 2D→hc_mult 流→2D 的完整旅程），收在出口+MTP 钩子；末节『code→diagram 方法论』（考纲 introduces 第三条）：教读者三步法——①registry 查表定位模型类 ②读 __init__ 树画积木框 ③沿 forward 走线画数据流——自己复现本章 L2 图。与前后章衔接：ch23 站 1/4/5/12 是本章 1/3/9/14 的直系前站；ch25 站 9（MLA 外层低秩链）与 ch26 全章（indexer/compressor/一核双源）是站 6/12 的内核侧；ch27 的 FP8/FP4 数学是站 8 的数值侧；ch32/33 消费站 14 的 MTP；ch34 深讲站 7 的 EP/SP；ch35（D4-Flash 进 96GB 部署实战）整章消费本章装配出的机器。

key_classes.name: DeepseekV4ForCausalLM
key_classes.responsibility: 顶层入口（NVIDIA 平台实现）：四件套契约（forward/compute_logits/load_weights/make_empty_intermediate_tensors）+get_mtp_target_hidden_states；bases 的 SupportsPP/SupportsEagle3/DeepseekV4MixtureOfExperts 是接口探测靶；set_moe_parameters 登记 MoE 元数据。对照 ch23 的 LlamaForCausalLM。

key_classes.name: DeepseekV4Model
key_classes.responsibility: 主干：embed→逐层（hc 4 元组穿针）→mhc_post→_mtp_hidden_buffer→hc_head→norm；持有三池（aux streams/eager scratch/topk buffer）与 PP 多流中间张量契约。EagleModelMixin 提供 aux 流重建。

key_classes.name: DeepseekV4DecoderLayer
key_classes.responsibility: 单层两半：attn（平台子类）+ffn（MoE）+双 RMSNorm（融进 hc 核）+六组 fp32 hc 混合参数；forward 是 mHC 门控骨架的字面载体。

key_classes.name: DeepseekV4Attention
key_classes.responsibility: 第三代 MLA 平台 ABC（包根，永不直接实例化）：共享投影装配（fused_wqa_wkv/q_norm/wq_b/kv_norm/wo_a/wo_b/attn_sink）+共享 forward（多流 GEMM+eager break）+四本账 spec 自报；平台子类实现 forward_mqa/_o_proj/get_padded_num_q_heads/backend_cls 四个抽象点。

key_classes.name: DeepseekV4FlashMLAAttention
key_classes.responsibility: NVIDIA FlashMLA 平台子类：头垫到 64/128；forward_mqa 分 prefill（分块 gather+combine+flash_mla_sparse_fwd）/decode（一核双源 flash_mla_with_kvcache）；_o_proj 走 deep_gemm_fp8_o_proj。同目录另有 FlashInfer 两子类（SM120/普通），amd/xpu 各有对应。

key_classes.name: DeepseekV4MoE
key_classes.responsibility: MoE 层：gate 路由（sqrtsoftplus/hash/noaux_tc 三模式）+shared_experts+双后端专家（MegaMoE/FusedMoE 二岔）；use_mega_moe 由 kernel_config.moe_backend 决定。

key_classes.name: DeepseekV4MegaMoEExperts
key_classes.responsibility: DeepGEMM MegaMoE 专家（EP 专用）：fp4 uint8 字节参数+UE8M0 scale；finalize_weights 变换 DeepGEMM 布局；对称缓冲跨层复用；手动注册 static_forward_context。SM100 限定。

key_classes.name: DeepseekV4MLP
key_classes.responsibility: dense MLP（shared_experts 用）：gate_up/down SwiGLU；block-FP8 下按 TP 块对齐补 intermediate 维（trailing ranks 落零垫）。

key_classes.name: GateLinear
key_classes.responsibility: MoE gate 线性层（ReplicatedLinear 子类）：六级 GEMM 分派（cuteDSL/DSV3 特化/fp32 特化/ cuBLAS/兜底）；out_dtype=fp32；挂 tid2eid（hash MoE）与 e_score_correction_bias（noaux_tc）两个路由附件。

key_classes.name: DeepseekV4FP8Config
key_classes.responsibility: V4 量化配置（Fp8Config 子类，注册名 deepseek_v4_fp8）：expert_dtype 惰性解析驱动 Mxfp4/Fp8/NvFp4 专家分发与线性 scale 精度（is_scale_e8m0）；override_quantization_method 是接入点。

key_classes.name: DeepseekV4Indexer
key_classes.responsibility: C4A 层的稀疏索引器（仅 compress_ratio==4 建）——ch26 主角，本章作积木引用：压缩坐标系+FP4/FP8 缓存+与 compressor 双流并行。

key_classes.name: DeepseekCompressor
key_classes.responsibility: KV/score 压缩机（compress_ratio>1 建）——ch26 已深讲，本章作积木引用：fused_wkv_wgate 一枪出 KV+score→save_partial_states→压缩写缓存。

key_classes.name: DeepseekV4SWACache
key_classes.responsibility: 滑窗支路缓存（每注意力层一本）：块 64 与 C4A KV 块共享物理张量（页大小对齐的约束源）；fp8_ds_mla uint8 或 plain bf16/fp8 双布局。

key_classes.name: DeepSeekV4MTP
key_classes.responsibility: MTP draft 模型：多层 DeepSeekV4MultiTokenPredictorLayer（e_proj/h_proj+复用 DecoderLayer）；forward 返 pre-hc_head 残差、compute_logits 里补 hc_head+shared_head；load_weights 带 mtp.* 重映射与完整性检查（缺层即报错，L493-L504）。

key_classes.name: DeepseekV4EagerScratchPool
key_classes.responsibility: eager break 内的全模型输出/草稿池（q_out/indexer_q/global_topk/compressor_scratch，256 对齐）——cudagraph 捕获段外的分配不经图缓存，池化防每拍裸分配。

data_flow: 本章不做独立 data_flow 重挖——沿 deepread/model-sample.json data_flow 步骤 2（模型前向段）下钻到 DSV4：该步骤里 Llama 的『LlamaModel.forward 逐层 LlamaDecoderLayer：RMSNorm→LlamaAttention→RMSNorm→MLP』在 V4 替换为 hc 门控两半+第三代 MLA+MoE。一拍之内（decode 步、单卡、无 spec）：① runner set_forward_context 挂全层 metadata（ch18/23 已立；V4 每层四本账各有 builder）→ ② 站 10：embed 出 2D hidden → 首层 mhc_pre_broadcast 核内展开 hc_mult 流（4 元组从此在层间穿针）→ ③ 站 11-12 每层两半：attn 半=mhc_fused_post_pre→[sp_all_gather]→多流输入 GEMM→fused_q_kv_rmsnorm→eager break（wq_b+kv_insert ‖ indexer ‖ compressor 三路）→forward_mqa（SWA+压缩 top-k 双源，归 ch26 站 14）→_o_proj（逆 RoPE+fp8 einsum 低秩）→[sp_reduce_scatter]；ffn 半=mhc_fused_post_pre→MoE（站 13：gate→sqrtsoftplus top-k→MegaMoE/FusedMoE→+=shared）→ ④ 层尾 mhc_post 塌回 3D→_mtp_hidden_buffer暂存→hc_head 压回→norm → ⑤ 站 14：runner 切采样位调 compute_logits（ch23 站 12 同款）；spec 开启时 drafter 输入被重绑为 pre-hc_head 残差（gpu_model_runner.py:L5198-L5206）→ MTP draft（e_proj/h_proj→复用 DecoderLayer→flat 残差，hc_head 推迟到 draft 的 compute_logits）。装配期（一生一次）流：arch 查表（站 1）→平台分发（站 2）→顶层/骨架/DecoderLayer/MLA/MoE/FP4 逐级 __init__（站 3-8）→权重流入+两步 finalize（站 9）→eval()。

why_chains.source_card: deepread/model-sample.json why_chains[8]（模型定义层=纯拼装+硬件隔离新布局）——本章主链
why_chains.decision: 模型定义层 = 平台无关层的纯拼装（模型文件只做层组装+权重名映射，attention 是插座不是实现）+ v0.27 新政：旗舰架构走 vllm/models/<name>/ 硬件隔离布局
why_chains.old_design: HF modeling_*.py 每个模型自带注意力实现与 KV 管理；vLLM 旧世代 model_executor/models/ 扁平目录一个 .py 塞全部平台分支（DSV4 迁移动机：git 287471b99 '[Model Refactoring] Migrate DeepSeek V4 to vllm/models/ [1/N]' #43004，2026-05）。v0.21 的 deepseek_v4.py 就是扁平布局的产物。
why_chains.pain: 新架构 = 重写一遍 attention+TP+量化胶水；同一 FlashAttention kernel 要为几十个模型各改一遍；平台分支（CUDA/ROCm/XPU）混在同一文件越长越不可维护——DSV4 这种深度依赖平台 kernel（FlashMLA/FlashInfer sparse/MegaMoE）的模型在扁平布局里已经没法读。
why_chains.solution: 本章站 1-6 逐条实证接入清单：①模型四件套+MTP 钩子（nvidia/model.py:L1457-L1548）②registry 条目全限定路径（registry.py:L95，_resolve_module_name L1439-L1446）③__init__.py 按 current_platform 分发（deepseek_v4/__init__.py:L17-L32）④注意力层平台 ABC：forward_mqa/_o_proj/get_padded_num_q_heads/backend_cls 四个抽象点（attention.py:L136-L173），nvidia/amd/xpu 各一份子类 ⑤量化分发 override（quant_config.py:L134-L152，注册进 quantization/__init__.py:L164）⑥static_forward_context 手动注册（attention.py:L327-L332、model.py:L253-L256——普通 Attention 自动做、V4 的 MoE/ABC 要手动）。
why_chains.cost: 接入税重（本章就是税单）：新架构作者要同时懂模型层契约（PP/TP/EPLB 接口、TP 头数整除断言）+ KV cache 规格体系（V4 一层四本账）+ 量化分发 + 编译装饰器；平台子类让『一层到底谁实现』要跨目录追（包根 ABC vs nvidia/amd/xpu）；新旧两套布局并存（DSV3.2 仍走 deepseek_v2.py 扁平，registry.py:L92-L94），读者要能分辨。

why_chains.source_card: deepread/model-sample.json why_chains[9]（MLA 三代演化）——DSV4 第三代段，本章 capstone 视角
why_chains.decision: MLA 三代演化：KV cache 只存压缩潜向量；DSV4 第三代=统一 head_dim=512 语义+fp8_ds_mla 584B/token+compress_ratio 上下文压缩+输出侧低秩
why_chains.old_design: MHA/GQA 每 token 缓存 K、V 各 num_kv_heads×head_dim；DSV2/V3 世代 576 维潜向量（ch24/25 已讲）。
why_chains.pain: 长上下文批量并发的显存天花板（ch25 的 40960→576 账）；V3.2 再上稀疏索引（ch26）后，KV 的『形状』成为三代分型的主轴。
why_chains.solution: DSV4（vllm/models/deepseek_v4/attention.py）：统一 head_dim=512；fp8_ds_mla UE8M0 块缩放 uint8 布局 584B/token（448 NoPE+128 RoPE+8 scale，vllm/v1/kv_cache_interface.py:L389-L420）；compress_ratio 逐层表（1/4/128 三类层，仅 C4A 带 indexer——L207-L213）；输出侧 o_lora_rank/o_groups 低秩（wo_a/wo_b，L245-L262）；alignment 576B 页对齐（L663-L674）；一层最多四本 KV 账（主 MLA/IndexerCache/CompressorStateCache/SWACache）。
why_chains.cost: 特形 KV 与所有通用后端不兼容→需要独立 backend 家族（MLAAttentionSpec 的 cache_dtype_str/alignment/compress_ratio 字段就是给 KV 账本分组的）；compress_ratio>1 的层读写都要经过压缩器，cache 命中/共享语义与普通层不同（ch26 已深讲）；prefill 上投影 workspace 的账（eager_scratch.py 即其产物）。

why_chains.source_card: deepread/model-sample.json why_chains[0]（forward 与 compute_logits 拆分）——本章在旗舰上的复验
why_chains.decision: forward 与 compute_logits 拆分：模型前向只出 hidden_states，lm_head 由 runner 在采样位切片后另调
why_chains.old_design: HF ForCausalLM.forward 一口气跑 lm_head 返回全位置 logits（训练语义）。
why_chains.pain: decode 批每请求只有最后 1 个 token 需要下一词分布；vocab≈13 万全量物化纯浪费；TP 下 gather 通信同倍放大。
why_chains.solution: DSV4 原样遵守（nvidia/model.py:L1522-L1532 forward 透传 hidden_states；L1515-L1520 compute_logits 两行调 LogitsProcessor）；采样位切片策略仍归 runner（gpu_model_runner.py:L4484-L4485，ch23 站 11）。V4 的新意：hc_head（多流压回单流）放在 Model.forward 尾部、compute_logits 之前——hidden_states 的『最终形态』在模型内部就定型；MTP draft 反向利用这一点把 hc_head 推迟到自己的 compute_logits（mtp.py:L253-L279），让 draft 消费 pre-hc_head 残差。
why_chains.cost: 模型类必须同时实现两方法+make_empty_intermediate_tensors（V4 还要多一个 get_mtp_target_hidden_states 可选钩子）；『哪里要 logits』策略分散在 runner。

why_chains.source_card: 本章新增分析（analyst 深读 v0.27.1 nvidia/model.py L519-L764 + config/kernel.py L121-L131）
why_chains.decision: MoE 双后端：同一份 gate/路由代码后面是两个完全不同的专家实现——kernel_config.moe_backend=='deep_gemm_mega_moe' 走 DeepseekV4MegaMoEExperts（EP 单算子），否则走通用 FusedMoE 工厂（TP）
why_chains.old_design: 通用 FusedMoE：TP 切专家、FusedMoEMethod 按量化方法分派 kernel——任何模型任何精度都能跑，但 DSV4 的 fp4 专家在通用路径上吃不到 SM100 的 DeepGEMM mega 融合红利。
why_chains.pain: 旗舰 MoE 的 expert GEMM 是算力大头：fp4 权重+top-k 散射在通用管线里要多次物化中间激活；EP（专家并行）才是大规模部署形态，通用 TP 路径对 EP 的对称缓冲/冗余专家没有一等支持。
why_chains.solution: 显式配置旋钮 kernel_config.moe_backend（vllm/config/kernel.py:L121-L131 合法值表、L191 字段）选 'deep_gemm_mega_moe'：①EP 强制（L536-L541，无 EP 直接 NotImplementedError 带修法提示）②sqrtsoftplus-only、fp4-only（L552-L561）③专家参数直接以 fp4 字节布局装载（w13=[E,2I,H/2]uint8+scale=[E,2I,H/32]UE8M0，L202-L246）④finalize_weights 变换成 DeepGEMM 布局后丢弃装载参数（L324-L362）⑤forward 一算子 deep_gemm.fp8_fp4_mega_moe(y, l1, l2, symm_buffer, activation_clamp, fast_math)（L505-L512），prepare_megamoe_inputs 把激活量化+top-k 重排进跨层复用的对称缓冲（get_symm_buffer 按 7 元组键缓存，L364-L391）。shared_experts 在 mega 路径 reduce_results=use_mega_moe（EP 下免 all_reduce）外部相加；fused 路径聚合进 FusedMoE。EPLB 冗余专家在 weight_loader 的 _map_global_expert_id（一逻辑专家可落多物理槽，L258-L266）。hash MoE：前 num_hash_layers 层免打分——tid2eid 查表（randint 初始化防 dummy 模式 garbage，L573-L587），路由数学归 fused_topk_bias 的 hash 分支（router L99-L107）。
why_chains.cost: ①mega 三重限定（EP+SM100+fp4+sqrtsoftplus）——硬件/部署强绑定，通用部署走 fused 路径②两套专家装配/装载/前向代码要并行维护（_init_mega/_init_fused、两套 expert_mapping）③对称缓冲按 max_num_batched_tokens 预分配（显存账）④finalize 后原参数置 None——权重热更新/EPLB 重排要走 get_expert_weights 的专用视图。

why_chains.source_card: 本章新增分析（analyst 深读 v0.27.1 quant_config.py 全文 + model.py L1217-L1417 权重装载）
why_chains.decision: FP4 落地=配置期惰性分发 + 字节级装载：expert_dtype 决定 Mxfp4MoEMethod/Fp8MoEMethod/NVFP4 与两套 scale 命名，e8m0fnu scale 以 uint8 原始字节装载
why_chains.old_design: 把量化决策写死在模型代码里（v0.21 的 DeepseekV4FP8Config 在 __init__ 急切读 hf_config）；scale 当普通张量 copy_。
why_chains.pain: ①VllmConfig 构造时 set_current_vllm_config 还没生效——急切读 expert_dtype 恒见默认 'fp4'，Flash-Base（fp8 专家）checkpoint 会被 silently misroute（quant_config.py:L43-L47 docstring NOTE 原话）②MXFP4 的 scale 是 UE8M0（纯指数浮点），torch 数值 copy_ 会把 2^-7 转成 0（model.py:L1270-L1279 注释：'destroying the raw exponent bytes'）③Mxfp4MoEMethod 与 Fp8LinearMethod 的 scale 注册名不同（weight_scale vs weight_scale_inv）——一套 checkpoint 名要按 expert_dtype 翻成两套参数名。
why_chains.solution: ①expert_dtype 做成 property 惰性解析（首次读到已生效的 vllm_config 才定型并 info_once）②装载期 float8_e8m0fnu → .view(torch.uint8) 按原始字节装（MegaMoE 的 _ue8m0_uint8_to_float=(sf.to(int32)<<23).view(float32) 在 finalize 时才还原，L310-L312）③per-instance WeightsMapper（model.py:L1383-L1417）：fp4 时 experts 的 '.scale'→'.weight_scale'、其余 '.scale'→'.weight_scale_inv'；fp8 时全部→'.weight_scale_inv'——模型类 __init__ 按 expert_dtype 选 mapper 实例。get_quant_method 分发树（quant_config.py:L173-L199）：RoutedExperts+fp4→Mxfp4MoEMethod（NVFP4 checkpoint 经 moe_quant_algo 走 ModelOptNvFp4FusedMoE）；fp8→Fp8MoEMethod。is_scale_e8m0=(expert_dtype=='fp4') 决定线性 scale 是 UE8M0 还是 f32。
why_chains.cost: ①『同一文件两类 scale 后缀』——读者/排障要时刻知道自己在哪条路径（mtp.py:L69-L77 专门注释镜像同款）②Quark 导出还要 from_config 翻译 schema（L154-L171）③block-FP8 的 TP 块对齐要求 shared_experts 装载补零（_pad_shared_expert_weight）——量化与并行的耦合又一处。

why_chains.source_card: deepread/model-sample.json why_chains[7]（spec decode drafter 谱系）MTP 段 + 本章新增分析（mhc/tilelang.py 与 L1131-L1215 主干）
why_chains.decision: mHC 多流残差 + MTP 钩子：残差从『加回去』升级为 hc_mult 条流的学习式混合；pre-hc_head 残差经 _mtp_hidden_buffer 喂 MTP draft
why_chains.old_design: 标准 add-norm 残差：hidden = hidden + attn_out，一条流（ch23 的 Llama 基线）；v0.21 的 DSV4 在 Model.forward 里显式 unsqueeze/repeat 展开多流、mhc 是 torch.ops.vllm 自定义算子。
why_chains.pain: 单流残差是信息瓶颈（梯度/表征都要挤一条道）；深模型里『加回去』的固定权重限制表达；而 MTP 要的 draft 输入必须是『还没被输出头定型』的残差形态——单流模型里这个中间形态根本不存在。
why_chains.solution: v0.27.1 形态：①残差流形=(residual (T,hc_mult,H), post_mix (T,hc_mult), comb_mix (T,hc_mult,hc_mult)) 三件套+2D layer 输入，层间 4 元组穿针（model.py:L899-L992）②每半层一个 mhc_fused_post_pre_tilelang（post+pre+RMSNorm 融合单核，tilelang.py:L433-L461）；首层 2D embed 由 mhc_pre_broadcast_tilelang 核内展开——finalize_mhc_broadcast_weights 把 (2+hc_mult,hc_mult,H) 的混合权预先对流维求和（fn_broadcast，L1371-L1380），因为 2D 输入各流相同③层尾 mhc_post 塌回 (T,hc_mult,H) 后**先** copy_ 进 _mtp_hidden_buffer（pre-hc_head 残差，L1200-L1202）再 hc_head 压回单流（L720-L748）④MTP 钩子：get_mtp_target_hidden_states（L1534-L1538）+ runner 侧 getattr 探测重绑（gpu_model_runner.py:L5198-L5206，'Let the target override the hidden state fed to the drafter'）⑤draft（mtp.py）：fused_mtp_input_rmsnorm 一核做 mask 首位+enorm+hnorm，hidden=h_proj(prev)+e_proj(embed)，复用整层 DeepseekV4DecoderLayer，返回 flat 残差、hc_head 推迟到自己的 compute_logits（L253-L279）——num_speculative_tokens>1 时 flat 残差还能续喂下一步。
why_chains.cost: ①每层六组 fp32 混合参数（(2+hc_mult)×hc_mult×H 量级）+Sinkhorn 归一超参（hc_sinkhorn_iters/hc_eps/hc_post_alpha=2.0）——参数与核复杂度税②PP 中间张量=多流形状（载荷×hc_mult）③hc 核真身在 tilelang_kernels（生成的核），Python 侧只见形状契约——教学只能讲到形状/数据流层（诚实边界，worked example 同此边界）④MTP draft 复用整层 DecoderLayer=每 draft 层一份 MoE 权重装载（mtp 完整性检查 L493-L504：checkpoint 缺 MTP 层直接报错）。

class DeepseekV4ForCausalLM(
    nn.Module, SupportsPP, SupportsEagle3, DeepseekV4MixtureOfExperts
):
    model_cls = DeepseekV4Model

    # Default mapper assumes the original FP4-expert checkpoint layout.
    # Overridden per-instance in __init__ when expert_dtype != "fp4".
    hf_to_vllm_mapper = _make_deepseek_v4_weights_mapper("fp4")

    def __init__(self, *, vllm_config: VllmConfig, prefix: str = ""):
        super().__init__()

        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
        self.config = config
        expert_dtype = getattr(config, "expert_dtype", "fp4")
        if expert_dtype != "fp4":
            self.hf_to_vllm_mapper = _make_deepseek_v4_weights_mapper(expert_dtype)

        self.model = self.model_cls(
            vllm_config=vllm_config, prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "model")
        )
        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
            self.lm_head = ParallelLMHead(
                config.vocab_size,
                config.hidden_size,
                prefix=maybe_prefix(prefix, "lm_head"),
            )
        else:
            self.lm_head = PPMissingLayer()
        self.logits_processor = LogitsProcessor(config.vocab_size)
        self.make_empty_intermediate_tensors = (  # type: ignore[method-assign]
            self.model.make_empty_intermediate_tensors
        )

        self.set_moe_parameters()

    def set_moe_parameters(self) -> None:
        self.num_expert_groups = getattr(self.config, "n_group", 1)
        self.num_moe_layers = self.config.num_hidden_layers
        self.moe_layers: list[nn.Module] = []
        self.moe_mlp_layers: list[DeepseekV4MoE] = []
        example_moe: DeepseekV4MoE | None = None
        for layer in self.model.layers:
            if isinstance(layer, PPMissingLayer):
                continue
            if not isinstance(layer, DeepseekV4DecoderLayer):
                continue
            if isinstance(layer.ffn, DeepseekV4MoE):
                example_moe = layer.ffn
                self.moe_mlp_layers.append(layer.ffn)
                self.moe_layers.append(layer.ffn.experts)

        self.num_moe_layers = len(self.moe_layers)
        self.extract_moe_parameters(example_moe)

# Three aux streams: one per non-default input GEMM in
        # DeepseekV4Attention.attn_gemm_parallel_execute
        # (compressor kv_score, indexer.weights_proj, indexer.compressor
        # kv_score). fused_wqa_wkv stays on the default stream.
        aux_stream_list = [torch.cuda.Stream() for _ in range(3)]
        padded_heads = _select_dsv4_attn_cls(vllm_config).get_padded_num_q_heads(
            config.num_attention_heads // get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
        )
        self.eager_scratch_pool: DeepseekV4EagerScratchPool | None = None
        if not vllm_config.parallel_config.use_ubatching:
            # TODO: support dbo if needed
            # this requires the buffer to have ubatch dim
            self.eager_scratch_pool = DeepseekV4EagerScratchPool(
                vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
                padded_heads,
                config.head_dim,
                config.index_n_heads,
                config.index_head_dim,
                config.index_topk,
                current_platform.device_type,
            )

        # Reserved topk indices buffer for all Indexer layers to reuse.
        self.topk_indices_buffer = torch.empty(
            vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
            config.index_topk,
            dtype=torch.int32,
        )

        if get_pp_group().is_first_rank:
            self.embed_tokens = VocabParallelEmbedding(
                config.vocab_size,
                config.hidden_size,
                quant_config=quant_config,
                prefix=f"{prefix}.embed_tokens",
            )
        else:
            self.embed_tokens = PPMissingLayer()

        self.start_layer, self.end_layer, self.layers = make_layers(
            config.num_hidden_layers,
            lambda prefix: DeepseekV4DecoderLayer(
                vllm_config,
                prefix=prefix,
                topk_indices_buffer=self.topk_indices_buffer,
                aux_stream_list=aux_stream_list,
                eager_scratch_pool=self.eager_scratch_pool,
            ),
            prefix=f"{prefix}.layers",
        )

        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank:
            self.norm = RMSNorm(config.hidden_size, self.rms_norm_eps)
        else:
            self.norm = PPMissingLayer()

        self.hc_head_fn = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(
                self.hc_mult,
                self.hc_dim,
                dtype=torch.float32,
            ),
            requires_grad=False,
        )
        self.hc_head_base = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(
                self.hc_mult,
                dtype=torch.float32,
            ),
            requires_grad=False,
        )
        self.hc_head_scale = nn.Parameter(
            torch.empty(1, dtype=torch.float32),
            requires_grad=False,
        )
        spec_config = vllm_config.speculative_config
        needs_mtp_hidden_states = spec_config is not None and (
            spec_config.use_eagle() or spec_config.uses_draft_model()
        )
        if get_pp_group().is_last_rank and needs_mtp_hidden_states:
            self._mtp_hidden_buffer = torch.empty(
                vllm_config.scheduler_config.max_num_batched_tokens,
                self.hc_dim,
                dtype=vllm_config.model_config.dtype,
            )
        else:
            self._mtp_hidden_buffer = None

def forward(
        self,
        x: torch.Tensor,
        positions: torch.Tensor,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor | None,
        post_mix: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        res_mix: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    ) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        attn_norm_weight = self.attn_norm.weight.data
        attn_norm_eps = self.attn_norm.variance_epsilon
        if residual is None:
            # Run standalone mhc_pre on first layer
            if x.dim() == 2:
                assert self.hc_attn_fn_broadcast is not None
                residual, post_mix, res_mix, x = mhc_pre_broadcast_tilelang(
                    x,
                    self.hc_attn_fn,
                    self.hc_attn_scale,
                    self.hc_attn_base,
                    self.rms_norm_eps,
                    self.hc_eps,
                    self.hc_eps,
                    self.hc_post_alpha,
                    self.hc_sinkhorn_iters,
                    norm_weight=attn_norm_weight,
                    norm_eps=attn_norm_eps,
                    fn_broadcast=self.hc_attn_fn_broadcast,
                )
            else:
                residual = x
                post_mix, res_mix, x = mhc_pre_tilelang(
                    x,
                    self.hc_attn_fn,
                    self.hc_attn_scale,
                    self.hc_attn_base,
                    self.rms_norm_eps,
                    self.hc_eps,
                    self.hc_eps,
                    self.hc_post_alpha,
                    self.hc_sinkhorn_iters,
                    norm_weight=attn_norm_weight,
                    norm_eps=attn_norm_eps,
                )
        else:
            residual, post_mix, res_mix, x = mhc_fused_post_pre_tilelang(
                x,
                residual,
                post_mix,
                res_mix,
                self.hc_attn_fn,
                self.hc_attn_scale,
                self.hc_attn_base,
                self.rms_norm_eps,
                self.hc_eps,
                self.hc_eps,
                self.hc_post_alpha,
                self.hc_sinkhorn_iters,
                n_splits=1,
                tile_n=1,
                norm_weight=attn_norm_weight,
                norm_eps=attn_norm_eps,
            )

        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
            x = sp_all_gather(x)[: positions.shape[0]]

        x = self.attn(positions, x, None)
        if self.use_sequence_parallel:
            x = sp_reduce_scatter(x)

        ffn_norm_weight = self.ffn_norm.weight.data
        ffn_norm_eps = self.ffn_norm.variance_epsilon
        residual, post_mix, res_mix, x = mhc_fused_post_pre_tilelang(
            x,
            residual,
            post_mix,
            res_mix,
            self.hc_ffn_fn,
            self.hc_ffn_scale,
            self.hc_ffn_base,
            self.rms_norm_eps,
            self.hc_eps,
            self.hc_eps,
            self.hc_post_alpha,
            self.hc_sinkhorn_iters,
            n_splits=1,
            tile_n=1,
            norm_weight=ffn_norm_weight,
            norm_eps=ffn_norm_eps,
        )

        x = self.ffn(x, input_ids)
        return x, residual, post_mix, res_mix

def __init__(
        self,
        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
        prefix: str,
        topk_indices_buffer: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        aux_stream_list: list[torch.cuda.Stream] | None = None,
        eager_scratch_pool: "DeepseekV4EagerScratchPool | None" = None,
    ) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        config = vllm_config.model_config.hf_config
        quant_config = vllm_config.quant_config
        cache_config = vllm_config.cache_config
        tp_size = get_tensor_model_parallel_world_size()
        layer_id = extract_layer_index(prefix)

        self.prefix = prefix  # Alias for compatibility with compressor
        self.hidden_size = config.hidden_size
        self.n_heads = config.num_attention_heads
        assert self.n_heads % tp_size == 0
        self.n_local_heads = self.n_heads // tp_size
        self.q_lora_rank = config.q_lora_rank
        self.o_lora_rank = config.o_lora_rank
        self.head_dim = config.head_dim
        self.rope_head_dim = config.qk_rope_head_dim
        self.nope_head_dim = self.head_dim - self.rope_head_dim
        self.n_groups = config.o_groups
        self.n_local_groups = self.n_groups // tp_size
        self.window_size = config.sliding_window
        # NOTE(zyongye) Compress ratio can't be 0
        # we do this for because MTP layer is not included
        # in the compress ratio list
        if layer_id < config.num_hidden_layers:
            self.compress_ratio = max(1, config.compress_ratios[layer_id])
        else:
            self.compress_ratio = 1
        self.eps = config.rms_norm_eps
        self.scale = self.head_dim**-0.5

        # Padded Q head count is dictated by the platform subclass.
        self.padded_heads = self.get_padded_num_q_heads(self.n_local_heads)
        # Sink padded to the same head count, initialized to -inf (no sink
        # effect). Weight loading fills the first n_local_heads slots.
        self.attn_sink = nn.Parameter(
            torch.full((self.padded_heads,), -float("inf"), dtype=torch.float32),
            requires_grad=False,
        )

        self.fused_wqa_wkv = MergedColumnParallelLinear(
            self.hidden_size,
            [self.q_lora_rank, self.head_dim],
            bias=False,
            quant_config=quant_config,
            prefix=f"{prefix}.fused_wqa_wkv",
            disable_tp=True,  # fused ReplicatedLinear
        )
        self.q_norm = RMSNorm(self.q_lora_rank, self.eps)
        self.wq_b = ColumnParallelLinear(
            self.q_lora_rank,
            self.n_heads * self.head_dim,
            bias=False,
            quant_config=quant_config,
            return_bias=False,
            prefix=f"{prefix}.wq_b",
        )

        self.kv_norm = RMSNorm(self.head_dim, self.eps)
        self.wo_a = ColumnParallelLinear(
            self.n_heads * self.head_dim // self.n_groups,
            self.n_groups * self.o_lora_rank,
            bias=False,
            quant_config=quant_config,
            return_bias=False,
            prefix=f"{prefix}.wo_a",
        )
        self.wo_a.is_bmm = True
        self.wo_a.bmm_batch_size = self.n_local_groups
        self.wo_b = RowParallelLinear(
            self.n_groups * self.o_lora_rank,
            self.hidden_size,
            bias=False,
            quant_config=quant_config,
            return_bias=False,
            prefix=f"{prefix}.wo_b",
        )

def forward(
        self,
        positions: torch.Tensor,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        llama_4_scaling: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        # Pre-allocate attention output with FlashMLA-padded head count.
        # The op writes into `o_padded`; we slice to n_local_heads after.
        num_tokens = hidden_states.shape[0]
        o_padded = torch.empty(
            (num_tokens, self.padded_heads, self.head_dim),
            dtype=hidden_states.dtype,
            device=hidden_states.device,
        )

        # Metadata-independent input GEMMs + RMSNorm stay in the captured
        # graph; the metadata-dependent rest (q up-proj + kv-insert, indexer,
        # compressor, MLA attention) runs in the eager break.
        qr_kv, kv_score, indexer_kv_score, indexer_weights = (
            self.attn_gemm_parallel_execute(hidden_states)
        )
        qr, kv = qr_kv.split([self.q_lora_rank, self.head_dim], dim=-1)
        qr, kv = fused_q_kv_rmsnorm(
            qr,
            kv,
            self.q_norm.weight.data,
            self.kv_norm.weight.data,
            self.eps,
        )

        # attention_impl is wrapped with @eager_break_during_capture: this is
        # where the breakable cudagraph capture breaks (the attention op runs
        # eagerly between captured graph segments).
        self.attention_impl(
            hidden_states,
            qr,
            kv,
            kv_score,
            indexer_kv_score,
            indexer_weights,
            positions,
            o_padded,
        )
        o = o_padded[:, : self.n_local_heads, :]

        # Inverse-RoPE + wo_a + wo_b output projection (platform-specific).
        return self._o_proj(o, positions)

@eager_break_during_capture
    def attention_impl(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        qr: torch.Tensor,
        kv: torch.Tensor,
        kv_score: torch.Tensor,
        indexer_kv_score: torch.Tensor,
        indexer_weights: torch.Tensor,
        positions: torch.Tensor,
        out: torch.Tensor,  # [num_tokens, padded_heads, head_dim], written in place
    ) -> None:
        forward_context = get_forward_context()
        attn_metadata = forward_context.attn_metadata

        # wq_b + kv_insert (+ MLA compressor when an indexer is present) ride
        # on the default stream so q stays on its consumer stream (forward_mqa
        # downstream reads q on default). Indexer/compressor go on aux for
        # overlap with default's GEMM + cache write.
        if self.indexer is not None:
            aux_streams = self.aux_stream_list
            indexer = self.indexer
            # Local ref so the closure keeps a non-None type for mypy.
            assert self.compressor is not None
            compressor = self.compressor

            def wq_b_kv_insert() -> torch.Tensor:
                q = self.wq_b(qr).view(-1, self.n_local_heads, self.head_dim)
                q = self._fused_qnorm_rope_kv_insert(q, kv, positions, attn_metadata)
                return q

            # 3-way overlap (matches TRT-LLM PR #14142 Level 1): default runs
            # wq_b+kv_insert; slot [0] runs the full indexer; slot [1] runs the
            # MLA compressor. Slot [2] is reserved for the indexer's inner
            # overlap. ROCm (aux_streams is None) falls back to sequential.
            q, _ = execute_in_parallel(
                wq_b_kv_insert,
                [
                    lambda: indexer(
                        hidden_states,
                        qr,
                        indexer_kv_score,
                        indexer_weights,
                        positions,
                        self.indexer_rotary_emb,
                    ),
                    lambda: compressor(kv_score, positions, self.rotary_emb),
                ],
                self.ln_events[0],
                [self.ln_events[1], self.ln_events[2]],
                [aux_streams[0], aux_streams[1]] if aux_streams is not None else None,
                enable=aux_streams is not None,
            )
        elif self.compressor is not None:
            # wq_b + kv_insert on default, compressor on aux.
            aux_stream = (
                self.aux_stream_list[0] if self.aux_stream_list is not None else None
            )
            compressor = self.compressor

            def wq_b_kv_insert() -> torch.Tensor:
                q = self.wq_b(qr).view(-1, self.n_local_heads, self.head_dim)
                q = self._fused_qnorm_rope_kv_insert(q, kv, positions, attn_metadata)
                return q

            q, _ = maybe_execute_in_parallel(
                wq_b_kv_insert,
                lambda: compressor(kv_score, positions, self.rotary_emb),
                self.ln_events[0],
                self.ln_events[1],
                aux_stream,
            )
        else:
            # SWA-only layer: no compressor, no overlap.
            q = self.wq_b(qr).view(-1, self.n_local_heads, self.head_dim)
            q = self._fused_qnorm_rope_kv_insert(q, kv, positions, attn_metadata)

        # MLA attention writes into the pre-allocated `out` buffer
        # ([num_tokens, padded_heads, head_dim]).
        self.forward_mqa(q, kv, positions, out)

def get_kv_cache_spec(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> KVCacheSpec | None:
        if (
            self.compress_ratio <= 1
        ):  # SWA part. Allocated separately as DeepseekV4SWACache.
            return None
        # fp8_ds_mla is a UE8M0 block-scaled uint8 layout and needs 576B
        # alignment; plain bf16 / per-tensor fp8 rows use natural element-size
        # pages.
        uses_fp8_ds_mla_layout = self.kv_cache_dtype == "fp8_ds_mla"
        return MLAAttentionSpec(
            block_size=vllm_config.cache_config.block_size,
            num_kv_heads=1,
            head_size=self.head_dim,
            dtype=torch.uint8 if uses_fp8_ds_mla_layout else self.kv_cache_torch_dtype,
            compress_ratio=self.compress_ratio,
            cache_dtype_str=self.kv_cache_dtype,
            alignment=576 if uses_fp8_ds_mla_layout else 512,
            model_version="deepseek_v4",
            kv_quant_mode=get_kv_quant_mode(self.kv_cache_dtype),

def compute_fp8_einsum_recipe() -> tuple[tuple[int, int, int], bool]:
    """fp8_einsum recipe + scale layout for the current GPU arch.

    SM90: FP32 block scales stay [g, r/128, d/128] → sfb_gran_mn=128.
    SM100: INT32 packed scales become [g, r, ...] → sfb_gran_mn=1.

    Returns ``(einsum_recipe, tma_aligned_scales)`` for ``deep_gemm_fp8_o_proj``.
    """
    cap = current_platform.get_device_capability()
    assert cap is not None, "DeepseekV4 attention requires a CUDA device"
    einsum_recipe = (1, 128, 128) if cap.major <= 9 else (1, 1, 128)
    tma_aligned_scales = cap.major >= 10
    return einsum_recipe, tma_aligned_scales


def deep_gemm_fp8_o_proj(
    o: torch.Tensor,
    positions: torch.Tensor,
    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
    wo_a: nn.Module,
    wo_b: nn.Module,
    *,
    n_groups: int,
    heads_per_group: int,
    nope_dim: int,
    rope_dim: int,
    o_lora_rank: int,
    einsum_recipe: tuple[int, int, int],
    tma_aligned_scales: bool,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """O projection: inverse RoPE + FP8 quant + einsum + wo_b.

    Shared by the FlashMLA and FlashInfer CUDA backends. ``einsum_recipe`` /
    ``tma_aligned_scales`` come from ``compute_fp8_einsum_recipe``.
    """
    o_fp8, o_scale = fused_inv_rope_fp8_quant(
        o,
        positions,
        cos_sin_cache,
        n_groups=n_groups,
        heads_per_group=heads_per_group,
        nope_dim=nope_dim,
        rope_dim=rope_dim,
        tma_aligned_scales=tma_aligned_scales,
    )
    z = torch.empty(
        (o.shape[0], n_groups, o_lora_rank),
        device=o.device,
        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
    )
    weight_scale = (
        wo_a.weight_scale if hasattr(wo_a, "weight_scale") else wo_a.weight_scale_inv
    )
    fp8_einsum(
        "bhr,hdr->bhd",
        (o_fp8, o_scale),
        (wo_a.weight, weight_scale),
        z,
        recipe=einsum_recipe,
    )
    return wo_b(z.flatten(1))

class DeepseekV4FP8Config(Fp8Config):
    """FP8 config for DeepSeek V4 with expert-dtype-aware MoE dispatch.

    DeepSeek V4 checkpoints always use FP8 block quantization for
    linear/attention layers. The MoE expert weights vary by checkpoint:
    - ``expert_dtype="fp4"`` (e.g. DeepSeek-V4-Flash): MXFP4 experts
      with ue8m0 (e8m0fnu) FP8 linear scales.
    - ``expert_dtype="fp8"`` (e.g. DeepSeek-V4-Flash-Base): FP8 block
      experts with float32 FP8 linear scales.

    The dispatch and the linear scale dtype are both keyed off
    ``expert_dtype`` from the model's hf_config; missing values default
    to ``"fp4"`` so existing FP4 checkpoints stay unchanged.

    NOTE: ``expert_dtype`` is resolved lazily because this config is
    constructed during VllmConfig setup, before ``set_current_vllm_config``
    is active. Reading hf_config eagerly in ``__init__`` would always see
    the default ``"fp4"`` and silently misroute Flash-Base checkpoints.
    """

    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self._resolved_expert_dtype: str | None = None
        self._resolved_moe_quant_algo: str | None = None
        self._nvfp4_config: ModelOptNvFp4Config | None = None
        # ``is_scale_e8m0`` is a property that resolves on first read,
        # by which time the current vllm_config has been set.

    @property
    def expert_dtype(self) -> str:
        if self._resolved_expert_dtype is None:
            try:
                hf_config = get_current_vllm_config().model_config.hf_config
            except Exception:
                # vllm_config not yet set; defer the decision until a
                # later call lands inside set_current_vllm_config.
                return "fp4"
            expert_dtype = getattr(hf_config, "expert_dtype", "fp4")
            if expert_dtype not in _DEEPSEEK_V4_EXPERT_DTYPES:
                raise ValueError(
                    f"Unsupported DeepSeek V4 expert_dtype={expert_dtype!r}; "
                    f"expected one of {_DEEPSEEK_V4_EXPERT_DTYPES}."
                )
            self._resolved_expert_dtype = expert_dtype
            from vllm.logger import init_logger

            init_logger(__name__).info_once(
                "DeepSeek V4 expert_dtype resolved to %r", expert_dtype
            )
        return self._resolved_expert_dtype

    @property
    def is_scale_e8m0(self) -> bool:
        # FP4 checkpoints store FP8 linear scales as e8m0fnu; FP8 expert
        # checkpoints (Flash-Base) store them as float32.
        return self.expert_dtype == "fp4"

def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        positions: torch.Tensor,
        previous_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        inputs_embeds: torch.Tensor | None = None,
        spec_step_index: int = 0,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        assert inputs_embeds is not None
        # Target stashes pre-hc_head residual as flat (T, hc_mult * D);
        # reshape to (T, hc_mult, D) — the training-time layout — before
        # the fused norm pass so both inputs are 3D-friendly.
        previous_hidden_states = previous_hidden_states.view(
            -1, self.hc_mult, self.config.hidden_size
        )
        # Fused: mask inputs at position 0 (not needed by MTP), enorm, hnorm.
        inputs_embeds, previous_hidden_states = fused_mtp_input_rmsnorm(
            inputs_embeds,
            positions,
            previous_hidden_states,
            self.enorm.weight.data,
            self.hnorm.weight.data,
            self.enorm.variance_epsilon,
            self.hc_mult,
        )
        if self.mtp_block.use_sequence_parallel:
            if envs.VLLM_MOE_SKIP_PADDING and is_forward_context_available():
                forward_context = get_forward_context()
                forward_context.is_padding = sp_padding_mask(
                    forward_context.is_padding, inputs_embeds
                )
            inputs_embeds = sp_shard(inputs_embeds)
            previous_hidden_states = sp_shard(previous_hidden_states)
        hidden_states = self.h_proj(previous_hidden_states) + self.e_proj(
            inputs_embeds
        ).unsqueeze(-2)
        hidden_states, residual, post_mix, res_mix = self.mtp_block(
            positions=positions, x=hidden_states, input_ids=None
        )
        hidden_states = mhc_post_tilelang(hidden_states, residual, post_mix, res_mix)
        if self.mtp_block.use_sequence_parallel:
            hidden_states = sp_all_gather(hidden_states)[: positions.shape[0]]
        # Return the flat pre-hc_head residual so it can be re-fed as the
        # next spec step's `previous_hidden_states` when
        # num_speculative_tokens > 1. hc_head is deferred to compute_logits.
        return hidden_states.flatten(1)

def compute_logits(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        spec_step_idx: int = 0,
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        current_step_idx = spec_step_idx % self.num_mtp_layers
        mtp_layer = self.layers[str(self.mtp_start_layer_idx + current_step_idx)]
        # MTP forward returns the pre-hc_head residual (T, hc_mult * D); apply
        # hc_head here so logits are computed from the dense hidden state.
        hidden_states = hidden_states.view(
            -1, mtp_layer.hc_mult, mtp_layer.config.hidden_size
        )
        hidden_states = hc_head_fused_kernel_tilelang(
            hidden_states,
            mtp_layer.hc_head_fn,
            mtp_layer.hc_head_scale,
            mtp_layer.hc_head_base,
            mtp_layer.rms_norm_eps,
            mtp_layer.hc_eps,
        )
        hidden_states = mtp_shared_head_rmsnorm(
            hidden_states,
            mtp_layer.shared_head.norm.weight.data,
            mtp_layer.shared_head.norm.variance_epsilon,
        )
        logits = self.logits_processor(mtp_layer.shared_head.head, hidden_states)
        return logits

def mhc_post_tilelang(
    x: torch.Tensor,
    residual: torch.Tensor,
    post_layer_mix: torch.Tensor,
    comb_res_mix: torch.Tensor,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.mhc.tilelang_kernels import (

        post_layer_mix.squeeze(-1),

def hc_head_fused_kernel_tilelang(
    hs_flat: torch.Tensor,
    fn: torch.Tensor,
    hc_scale: torch.Tensor,
    hc_base: torch.Tensor,
    rms_eps: float,
    hc_eps: float,
) -> torch.Tensor:
    """Apply the fused hc_head kernel and return the (T, H) bf16 result."""
    num_tokens, hc_mult, hidden_size = hs_flat.shape
    out = torch.empty(
        num_tokens, hidden_size, dtype=torch.bfloat16, device=hs_flat.device
    )
    if num_tokens == 0:
        return out
    from vllm.model_executor.kernels.mhc.tilelang_kernels import hc_head_fuse_tilelang

    hc_head_fuse_tilelang(
        hs_flat,
        fn,
        hc_scale,
        hc_base,
        out,
        hidden_size,
        rms_eps,
        hc_eps,
        hc_mult,
    )
    return out

def _topk_softplus_sqrt_torch(
    topk_weights: torch.Tensor,
    topk_indices: torch.Tensor,
    token_expert_indices: torch.Tensor,
    gating_output: torch.Tensor,
    renormalize: bool = False,
    e_score_correction_bias: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    input_tokens: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    hash_indices_table: torch.Tensor | None = None,
    routed_scaling_factor: float = 1.0,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]:
    """Pure PyTorch fallback for topk_softplus_sqrt (XPU/CPU)."""
    # scores = sqrt(softplus(gating_output))
    scores = torch.sqrt(F.softplus(gating_output.float()))

    # Bias is used for expert SELECTION only, not for weight computation.
    # Using biased scores as weights flattens the distribution when the bias
    # is near-uniform (e.g., DSv4-Flash where all biases ≈ 8.08).
    if e_score_correction_bias is not None:
        scores_for_choice = scores + e_score_correction_bias.float()
    else:
        scores_for_choice = scores

    topk = topk_weights.shape[-1]

    if hash_indices_table is not None and input_tokens is not None:
        # Hash MoE: expert indices predetermined by lookup table
        # hash_indices_table: [vocab_size, topk] mapping token_id -> expert_ids
        expert_ids = hash_indices_table[input_tokens.long()]  # [M, topk]
        topk_indices.copy_(expert_ids)
        # Gather weights from unbiased scores
        weights = scores.gather(1, expert_ids.long())
    else:
        # Standard topk selection using biased scores
        _, indices = torch.topk(scores_for_choice, k=topk, dim=-1)
        topk_indices.copy_(indices)
        # Gather weights from unbiased scores
        weights = scores.gather(1, indices)

    if renormalize:
        weights = weights / (weights.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-20))

    topk_weights.copy_(weights * routed_scaling_factor)
    return topk_weights, topk_indices
